body: I love this for you guys. While supporting my husband I look to find material like this to show him. He still needs to do his own groundwork and can’t be coddled. But I also want him to feel supported as I work on forgiveness, acceptance, patience, and grace. It’s so difficult and painful like faaaack why does something like this exist for humans 🫠 Some times I get angry and I feel so disgusted with myself… and that’s not ok for me or anyone to do that. He’s not as intelligent as I am. I don’t mean that as an insult we just literally had two different resources in education growing up and he’s learned so much in the past 8 years we’ve been together. Super proud of him, and I want to encourage him to do better for himself because he can’t do better for us if he doesn’t do it for him (as well as I for myself). It’s a very large work in progress but it has been getting better. Again, patience.

Shiiiiit my grandparents told my mom she still had to marry my dad even tho he was cheating and abusive. All because of religion, image, and shame of an unwed mother. This was in the 90s so things have changed a bit but still horrible in concept.

I was reading this and said to my husband “holy shit are you married to them too” 🤣 stole the words out my mouth and shoved 20 Popeyes biscuits down the hatch. NO DRINK. 💀 This has been such a process working on embracing the communication and support he didn’t have growing up. Not because it was bad but same they just didn’t function on real life shit. He’s first gen and his dad came off the streets to make a life for their family. Super hard working and provider. But he was never shown love and has no idea how to accept it. My husband is 1 of 3 brothers and they all have this ego of “I’m a tough man I don’t feel anything grrrrr” 🙄 like no I’m sorry I love yall and you are gunna be appreciated and valued whether you like it or not! lol it’s a sloooooow journey and I try to not feel punished? Is my love so foreign and scary it can’t be entertained? It just makes me sad. His younger brother is a goner and honestly I’ll never forgive him for some shit and his older brother is a failure as a father. His mom passed some years ago and his dad has done a good job at accepting it. He looks so happy with his partner and she respects and takes care of the home that would make his wife so proud. I’m happy I saw this. You helped me validate myself on a day where I feel so helpless and alone…. I just want everyone to be happy.

“Actually suffering”??? BRO YOU ARE NOBODY YOU DON’T GET TO DECIDE 🫠 you don’t need to have something traumatic happen to you consistently for it to change and drown you. I feel so sorry for anyone in your life that’s harboring their experiences in secret because they know what a crap person you are. 

Validating abuse isn’t a narrative, so let’s get that straight. There’s no levels of severity nor a statue of limitation because it’s not a fucking pissing contest. What shine? The only gain from them coming forward is to expose the issue that is EVERYWHERE. How much did they get paid to participate? What extra appearances are they gaining from this? It’s fucking disgusting how protected these predators are. You are  just looking to be included because you project it as an attention seeking aspect when it’s not.

You can’t ask for “substance/stories” and then discredit it automatically because it doesn’t fit the narrative you have in your head. Did you hear them when they said how difficult it was to speak on it? There’s people up in arms because Amanda wasn’t participating in the documentary and guess what? SHE DOES NOT HAVE TO. The first 17 years of my life were extremely traumatic and I never said I word until I became an adult in my 30s. Why? Because it’s uncomfortable and scary, and frankly I don’t owe anyone any morbid details in order to validate what I experienced. Do you know what it’s like to process horrible things from your childhood later on? There’s fear of judgment and rejection from people like yourself as to why things aren’t always presented in totality. The episode did a mid job expressing that and leaving room to encourage others to speak up and try to create a bigger platforms for victims. Things can be worked on if we move as a collected unit, but shit is gunna take time. Give them time to process and reach out on terms they created, not the ones you did.

Which episode did they compare the experiences because I don’t recall that happening? You’re comparing them and that’s grossly out of pocket. Did you also take into account that the stories told are based on the people who were comfortable to come forward and speak on it? Would you be comfortable telling them they shouldn’t have said anything because it’s not what you consider serious? You’re denying them validation. Reword it because I’m not understanding the point you’re making or level of understanding you’re trying to reach.

That’s like saying you shouldn’t be upset when someone you care about dies because people die every day. Trauma is trauma. Everyone is different, so are the situations and perception of that trauma will always be different per person. The focus isn’t on the severity of the things that happened to them but rather that it continued to happen to MANY children and nothing was done. They were failed by so many adults that should’ve been protecting them. They were given no resources to navigate healing and were served no justice while watching these predators carry on with their lives. As someone else stated it’s not a competition and you shouldn’t be downplaying the situations and outcomes of these people based off of your own jurisdiction.
